scenarios.title: Near-duplicate search queries
scenarios.description: Agent issues slightly different search queries that are syntactically close and semantically equivalent.

events.question: Summarize recent earnings for ACME Corp.
events.observation: News articles about ACME Corp Q4 2025 earnings.
events.response: ACME Corp reported strong Q4 2025 earnings with revenue growth of 15%.

events.question: Summarize recent earnings for ACME Corp.
events.observation: Very similar articles about ACME Corp Q4 2025 earnings.
events.response: The Q4 FY25 earnings for ACME Corp were strong with double-digit revenue growth.

events.question: Summarize recent earnings for ACME Corp.
events.observation: The same earnings news pages as before.
events.response: ACME's quarterly earnings for Q4 2025 show continued strong performance.

scenarios.title: Paraphrased planning loop
scenarios.description: Agent repeatedly refines a plan in semantically similar ways without changing the underlying strategy.

events.question: Design a 3-step onboarding flow for new users.
events.response: Refined plan: 1) Welcome message, 2) Interactive product tour, 3) short satisfaction survey.
